idea-plugin.name: STAMP Annotations
idea-plugin.description:
Shows, beside each line of a file, the STAMP that introduced it: the commit, as the Status, Time, Author, Module and Path coordinates a Tinkar version carries. The attribution comes from a first-parent history walk over the repository, honoring .git-blame-ignore-revs, so a formatting reflow never takes authorship. Lines changed in the editor but not yet committed show no STAMP: theirs is made at commit time.

Annotate with STAMPs (gutter menu, VCS menu) opens the gutter; clicking a STAMP highlights every line it introduced. Affirm, Refute and Comment on Selected Lines record a review of a range as an empty commit, signed by default, whose body is the annotation text and whose Annotation: trailers name the kind as a Koncept reference; the walker attaches them to those lines as affirmed, refuted or commented on, and an edit lapses them.

Design: dev-stamp-adoc-attribution, dev-stamp-annotation and dev-annotation-trailer in ike-lab-documents; tracked in IKE-Network/ike-issues#468 and #1300.

action.description: Show, beside each line, the STAMP (commit) that introduced it
Record an empty commit affirming the selected lines as committed at HEAD
Record an empty commit refuting the selected lines as committed at HEAD, with your reason
Record an empty commit commenting on the selected lines as committed at HEAD
